headline: Reserve Bank of India Allots ₹75,006 Crore in 3-Day Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India allotted ₹75,006 crore in its 3-day variable rate repo auction with a cut-off rate of 5.60% and a weighted average rate of 5.66%. Total bids received amounted to ₹1,35,656 crore against a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore.
why: Variable rate repo auctions are liquidity management tools used by central banks to absorb or inject funds into the banking system, directly influencing short-term interbank rates.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: The repo auction directly manages rupee liquidity in India's banking system.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The auction results reflect short-term liquidity conditions and bidding demand among commercial banks participating in the RBI's liquidity operations.
